tutorial: No wiki tutorial covers the window tools. The model starts from the repo's own live script reset (scripts/live/reset.json: it rebuilds the WindowTest document: a Body with a 20 mm pad) and walks the dev, unattended, notes, app, core and view tools once each, reads only where a read proves the point. docs/hardening/models/coredoc-gui-model.json (the earlier pass) is the deeper click-by-click script for the same tools; this one is the call list in the shape of bimcam-cam-model.json.

conventions.reset: Call 0 (live_run reset) runs first. The model is one batch; if it is answered in parts, a part that starts after call 0 repeats it, and one that starts between 22 and 26 starts at 22 instead.
conventions.refused: An expect starting REFUSED means isError with that code.
conventions.window: All calls go to the window's link. Nothing here takes the cursor, focus or full screen.
conventions.references: Calls 24, 25 and 26 take the note's id from call 22's answer: { "$from": 22, "$at": "note.id" } (an integer, as note_answer wants; the answer shape read live in the unproven-hub model, call 114). They reach at most four calls back.

expected.note: The WindowTest body's numbers are the reset script's: read them from session_state in call 2 rather than from here; I did not run the script.

app_restart, app_force_restart, app_install { version }, addon install / update / remove, pref_import, pref_pack { apply }: they restart FreeCAD, download, or change the person's settings; by hand only, with the person's say
menu_run: titles differ between FreeCAD 1.1.0 and 1.1.3 menus; coredoc-gui-model has the call
gui_input clicks and drags, dialogs: coredoc-gui-model.json covers them step by step
addon_test { addon }: starts a separate FreeCAD process for minutes; run once by hand: addon_test { addon: "AgentLink", select: "test_paths" }
batch, job_start, export, collab, history_checkpoint, history_restore, app_extensions: other passes' models (coredoc, map) or another add-on's tools
the tools of bim_gaps, cam_more, fem_more and std_more: all are rows in the earlier findings (bimcam, sheetfem, part, partdesign, coredoc) with their own models; nothing was left unchecked there
